title: Answer: a self is a bounded agent with memory and reference frames

statements.text: A self is an agent: a system with a boundary, quantum reference frames that give its measurements meaning, and a memory sector, whose self-representation goes back to the stress response of basal organisms.

sources.quote: Given the standard free-choice assumption, the intuitive idea of an “agent” or IGUS can be fully formulated within background-independent, scale-free quantum information theory.
